added.state: CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_messages_pending_poll ON public.outbox_messages USING btree (priority DESC, created_at) WHERE (((status)::text = 'pending'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))|valid=true|ready=true

CREATE INDEX idx_outbox_messages_retry_poll ON public.outbox_messages USING btree (next_retry_at, priority DESC) WHERE (((status)::text = 'failed'::text) AND (deleted_at IS NULL))|valid=true|ready=true
CREATE TRIGGER trg_outbox_new_message AFTER INSERT ON public.outbox_messages FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.status)::text = 'pending'::text)) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_outbox_new_message()|enabled=O

CREATE TRIGGER trg_outbox_reprocess_message AFTER UPDATE ON public.outbox_messages FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((((old.status)::text <> 'pending'::text) AND ((new.status)::text = 'pending'::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION public.notify_outbox_new_message()|enabled=O
